note: All dates are season-relative fractions, not Gregorian dates. Negative winter-relative leaf-fall occurs in preceding autumn. Engine has no per-roof or per-tree first-frost event: actual frost-bearing ground decal identities are listed separately. These are renderer timing observations, not simulated weather or temperature. Forest oldBare fractions describe treeProgression; old countryside ignored bare while waiting for snow. No old countryside leaf-fall claim follows from oldBare fractions.
